duplicate_source.title: Sensor {entity} is selected more than once
duplicate_source.description:
The sensor {entity} is selected as more than one meter ({roles}). Its energy is then counted twice and the flows are wrong.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Electricity Flow → Configure** and select it only once.

source_unavailable.title: Meter {entity} is unavailable
source_unavailable.description:
The energy meter {entity} has been missing, unavailable or not a number for more than an hour. Until it is back the flows are incomplete.

Check the integration that provides this sensor, or select another meter via **Settings → Devices & services → Electricity Flow → Configure**. This message disappears by itself when the meter works again.

source_invalid_unit.title: Meter {entity} has an unsupported unit
source_invalid_unit.description:
The energy meter {entity} reports in {unit}, but Electricity Flow needs Wh, kWh or MWh. Its energy is not counted.

Select an energy meter (not a power sensor in W) via **Settings → Devices & services → Electricity Flow → Configure**.

price_unavailable.title: No price from {entity}
price_unavailable.description:
The price from {entity} has been unavailable or not a number for more than an hour. Costs are calculated with the last valid price meanwhile, or not at all if there never was one.

Check the price sensor or template via **Settings → Devices & services → Electricity Flow → Configure**. This message disappears by itself when a valid price is back.

price_invalid_unit.title: Price {entity} has an unsupported unit
price_invalid_unit.description:
The price entity {entity} has the unit {unit}, which is not a price per energy. Use a price in for example EUR/kWh, ct/kWh or EUR/MWh. No costs are calculated with this price.

Change it via **Settings → Devices & services → Electricity Flow → Configure**.

price_currency.title: Price {entity} is in another currency
price_currency.description:
The price entity {entity} is in {currency}, but Home Assistant uses {expected}. Electricity Flow does not convert currencies, so the cost sensors would show the wrong amount.

Use a price in {expected}, or change the currency in **Settings → System → General**.
